app: proyecto-final

service: api-usuarios

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.12
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  timeout: 30
  iam:
    role: arn:aws:iam::659277875740:role/LabRole
  environment:
    USERS_TABLE: ${self:custom.tableName}
    ACCESOS_TABLE: ${self:custom.accessTableName}

custom:
  tableName: t_usuario-${self:provider.stage}
  accessTableName: t_access_token-${self:provider.stage}
  pythonRequirements:
    dockerizePip: true

functions:
  register:
    name: CreateUser
    handler: Lambda_UserCreate.lambda_handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /user/register
          method: post
          cors: true
          integration: lambda

  login:
    name: LoginUser
    handler: Lambda_UserLogin.lambda_handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /user/login
          method: post
          cors: true
          integration: lambda
  
  validateToken:
    name: ValidateToken
    handler: Lambda_ValidateAccessToken.lambda_handler

resources:
  Resources:
    UsuariosTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:custom.tableName}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: tenant_id
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: sort_id
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: email
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: tenant_id
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: sort_id
            KeyType: RANGE
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: EmailIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: tenant_id
                KeyType: HASH
              - AttributeName: email
                KeyType: RANGE
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL

    AccesosTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:custom.accessTableName}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: token
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: token
            KeyType: HASH
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        TimeToLiveSpecification:
          AttributeName: expires_ts
          Enabled: true
